title: A finite standard-open free cover gives finite presentation and flatness
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $N$ an $R$-module. If there are finitely many elements $f_1,\dots,f_r\in R$ generating the unit ideal such that each localization $N_{f_i}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] is a finite free $R_{f_i}$-module, then $N$ is finitely presented and flat as an $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00NX (lemma-finite-projective), implications (7) => (4) => (5) => (1) (finite locally free gives finitely presented by Lemma lemma-cover; flatness is checked locally by Lemma lemma-flat-localization)

proof.text: Let $s=\{f_1,\ldots,f_r\}$. The unit-ideal hypothesis on the finite list is exactly $\operatorname{Ideal.span}(s)=\top$. For each $f_i$, the assumed finite free module $N_{f_i}$ is finitely presented and flat by [lem-sc-affine-standard-cover-finite-free-local-fp-flat].

Apply the unit-ideal localization-span theorem for finite presentation [lem-sc-affine-standard-cover-finite-presentation-localization-span] to the family of localizations $N_{f_i}$. It yields that $N$ is finitely presented over $R$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00NX, chain (7) => (4) => (5) => (1), with Lemma Tag 00EO part (3)

proof.text: Apply the unit-ideal localization-span theorem for flatness [lem-sc-affine-standard-cover-flat-localization-span] to the same family. It yields that $N$ is flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
